Title: Questions: Aabbt Kindred, forced awakening-Delaying tactics, aching beauty

Messages.Author: Oortje
Messages.Body:
Question 1.
Can my Aabbt Kindred perform D-actions if I put Nefretiti in play with
a spell of life?

Question 2.
If I put aabbt Kindred in play via spell of life do the ally aabbt
kindred contest with the non-unique vampires or just each other?

Question 3.
Vamp A calls a vote.Vamp B has 1 blood. There is no block attempt.
Vamp B plays forced awakening and tries to play a delaying tactics. Is
this allowed? Do you have to pay the blood for the forced awakening
first for not blocking?

Question 4.
If my prey dies during an action due to my aching beauty. What happens
to my action? If it is directed at him does it fail because there no
legal target anymore? If it was undirected can my new prey attempt to
block?

Thanks in advance,
Oortje

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Oortje wrote:
> Question 1.
> Can my Aabbt Kindred perform D-actions if I put Nefretiti in play with
> a spell of life?

While Nefertiti remains in play and ready, yes. It doesn't matter that this
Nefertiti is a mummy. It's still "Nefertiti".

> Question 2.
> If I put aabbt Kindred in play via spell of life do the ally aabbt
> kindred contest with the non-unique vampires or just each other?

Just each other.
http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/fd1518b5bd58b116

> Question 3.
> Vamp A calls a vote.Vamp B has 1 blood. There is no block attempt.
> Vamp B plays forced awakening and tries to play a delaying tactics. Is
> this allowed?

No.

> Do you have to pay the blood for the forced awakening
> first for not blocking?

Yes.

> Question 4.
> If my prey dies during an action due to my aching beauty. What happens
> to my action? If it is directed at him does it fail because there no
> legal target anymore? If it was undirected can my new prey attempt to
> block?

If it is directed at the ousted Methuselah, it will fizzle when it reaches
resolution unblocked. The new prey can attempt to block if eligible.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Seeds of Corruption doesn't affect uniqueness.

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/?line=rulings

"Special ability" includes all text except terms (i.e., it doesn't include Clan,
Sect, Title, Unique (or not), Blood Cursed, Circle, Flight, Infernal, Scarce,
Slave, Sterile, Vulnerability, Anarch, Black Hand, Seraph, Red List).

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:


No.

Unique cards contest other unique cards with the same card.

If there's a non-unique card with the same name, you ignore it entirely
(for the purposes of contesting).

>> True: Aching Beauty doesn't cause pool loss until the block is successful..

>
> Masika attempt KRC.
>
> Prey attempts to block.
>
> Prey block sucessful and should pay for Aching Beaty and because this
> xe die at this time. Corret?

Yes.

> Thus, the action is blocked and the blocking methuselah is ousted
> before combat begins, ending the action. Corret?

Almost.

Combat is canceled (since one of the would-be combatants isn't ready), yes.

The action isn't quite over yet, though. The acting minion could still play some
effects (superior Freak Drive, for example).

> Once the action is already blocked and ended, how is blocked again by
> another player?

It isn't.

The claim above that the action, already blocked, could be blocked again by the
new prey is not correct, as pointed out above.
